I'll query the MedCP database to answer these questions about pulmonary embolism diagnosis patterns. Let me start by exploring the available tables and then run targeted queries.

I'll run three queries in parallel: (1) PE encounter volume and D-dimer ordering rates, (2) D-dimer positivity among those ordered, and (3) top condition/procedure clusters in PE-confirmed vs PE-excluded encounters.

arguments.sql_query:
-- 1. PE diagnosis codes used
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT vo.visit_occurrence_id) AS pe_encounters
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%pulmonary embolism%' 
   OR LOWER(c.concept_synonym synonym_name) LIKE '%pulmonary embolism%'
GROUP BY concept_id, concept_name
ORDER BY pe_encounters DESC
LIMIT 15

-- 1. PE diagnosis codes and encounter counts
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_source_id) AS num_patients, COUNT(*) AS num_occurrences
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%pulmonary embolism%'
GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name
ORDER BY num_patient DESC
LIMIT 15

-- D-dimer concept IDs and total count in the OMOP database
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, standard_concept, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%d-dimer%' 
   OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ddimer%'
   OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%d dimer%'
GROUP BY concept_id, concept_name, standard_concept
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20

-- Top PE-adjacent diagnoses (to define index encounters)
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dyspnea%' 
   OR LOWER(c.conconcept_name) LIKE '%pleuritic pain%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hypoxia%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%chest pain%'
GROUP BY concept_id, concept_name
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20
